description: This PHP class 'OAuthCodeMarkDeletedService' provides functionality to mark OAuth2 authorization codes as deleted in the database if they have expired beyond a certain threshold. It includes methods for database interaction, logging, and configuration retrieval.

classes.name: OAuthCodeMarkDeletedService
classes.description: Service class responsible for updating expired OAuth2 authorization codes as deleted in the database.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the process to update OAuth2 codes that have expired beyond the threshold to be marked as deleted.

methods.name: getDBManager
methods.description: Retrieves the database manager instance, throws exception if connection fails.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages at a specified level using the global log object.

methods.name: getOAuthCodeDeleteThreshold
methods.description: Fetches the OAuth code delete threshold from configuration, defaults to '-7 days' if invalid or not set.
